item.title: Open Memex 0.6.0
item.description:
## Highlights
Open Memex 0.6.0 makes long notes easier to move around in. The Command bar now works, you can find text in the open note, every note gets an Outline of its headings, and the caret stays where you type or click in headings.
### What's new since v0.5.0
- **Command palette.** Click the Command bar (`search · ask · run`) or press ⌘K anywhere in the workspace. One input finds app commands by name, notes and canvases by title, and Passages of note text by keyword and by meaning. Choosing a Passage opens its note scrolled to that passage, with a brief highlight. The preview pane shows the selected result when the window is wide enough. With an empty input, the palette lists your recent notes. - **Meaning search.** Passages use the same local model as Echoes. If the vault doesn't have the model yet, the palette shows keyword matches and offers to download it (local vaults). Hosted vaults search through the vault server. - **Find in note.** ⌘F opens the Find bar over the open note, in live preview and in Source mode. Matches are highlighted and the counter shows where you are; Enter and ⌘G step forward, Shift+Enter and ⇧⌘G step back, and ⌘E uses the selection. Matches inside excerpt cards and tables count, and a match inside hidden markup, such as a link address, reveals that line when you step to it. Edit ▸ Find in the menu bar now works too. - **Outline.** A new Outline tab in the right panel lists the open note's headings, indented by level. Click a heading to jump to it; the current section follows as you scroll. ⌘⇧O opens the Outline from anywhere, and the arrow keys, Enter and Esc work in the list. - **Steadier caret in headings.** Typing `#` and spaces in a heading moves the caret at once, and clicking a heading, a bold line or a link line keeps the caret where you clicked when the markup appears. - **`memex search`.** The CLI has a new `memex search` command, and the vault server a matching search route, both used by the Command palette.
## Upgrade
Self-update offers 0.6.0 to 0.5.0 installs; earlier builds install it by hand from this Release. No vault changes. Vaults made by earlier builds at schema V8 open as they are. A 0.6.0 app connected to an older vault server shows Passages as needing a server update; everything else keeps working.
## Requirements
Apple silicon Mac, macOS 14 or later.

item.title: Open Memex 0.5.0
item.description:
## Highlights
Open Memex 0.5.0 can update itself. When a newer Release is out, the app tells you, installs it and relaunches into it when you say so.
### What's new since v0.4.0
- **Self-update.** The app checks the Appcast once a day, silently, at launch. You can also choose Open Memex → Check for Updates… at any time, from the vault picker or an open vault. The check stays quiet when you're up to date, offline or the check fails, and opens a window only when a newer Release is available. - **You stay in control.** The window shows the new Release with its notes. Choosing install downloads the DMG, and you can close the window while it downloads. Nothing relaunches until you choose relaunch. - **Signed updates only.** The app checks the download's signature against the Open Memex release key before it stages anything. A tampered or unsigned download is refused and deleted. - **Unsent text is safe.** Relaunch warns about unsent hosted text the same way Quit does, and asks at most once. - **Agents keep running.** An update doesn't stop agents that are running: connected agents keep using the current memex until they restart. The window says so when agents are connected. - **Update ready.** Once an update is downloaded, the sidebar and vault picker version label reads "update ready". Click it to get back to the relaunch prompt. - **When it can't install.** If the app's folder can't be written, or the app is running from a disk image, the window says so plainly. For a folder that can't be written it links to the Release so you can download it by hand. If an install fails after the app quits, the old app stays in place and the next launch tells you why. - **Debug builds** never offer to replace themselves.
### Privacy
The app now makes one request a day to GitHub Pages to fetch the Appcast. The DMG is downloaded only when you choose to install. No vault data is sent.
## Upgrade
v0.4.0 and earlier have no Self-update, so install 0.5.0 by hand: download the DMG from this Release and replace the app. From 0.5.0 on, updates come through Self-update. No schema migration in this release. No vault changes. Vaults made by earlier builds open as they are.
## Requirements
Apple silicon Mac, macOS 14 or later.
